findings.title: tests/run.sh buffers each test's output and prints it only after the child exits, so a timed-out or reaped suite — the exact "stopped short" case this classifier reports on exit 124/137/143 — leaves the in-flight test's diagnostics out of the verify evidence log entirely

docs/configuration.md describes `handoff.pin_check` as "the check the `handoff` route runs", but it is now executed before every `orchid verify`, passing or failing, and the shipped default builds a full release archive; the per-verify cost and timing are only stated in a code comment
